scope: Public prior-work notes for a new standalone operation/receipt/decision experiment. Focused coverage, not an exhaustive survey.
experimental_results: None asserted in this literature package. Scientific claims must use fresh independent implementation and observations.

clusters.public_prior_claim: A failed call can leave its effect uncertain. Stable operation identity, durable completion evidence, retry routing and safe record reclamation are established execution concerns.
clusters.relevance: Define logical operation identity separately from delivery attempt identity. State what a retained receipt proves and when replay recognition expires.
clusters.limits: RIFL requires atomic completion metadata and mutation and couples safe reclamation to acknowledgements/client validity. A separate receipt and effect store does not inherit those guarantees.

clusters.public_prior_claim: Logged recovery, replaying retained nondeterministic results and durable task boundaries precede this experiment. Post-restoration semantic drift is already documented.
clusters.relevance: A decision-persistence experiment should distinguish reusing an operation identifier from retaining the selected operation arguments. Measure those as separate policies.
clusters.limits: Beldi assumes its API/storage model. ARIES is database-level logged recovery. ACRFence evaluates attacks and proposes an unimplemented replay-or-fork mitigation. Neither a JSON decision nor a receipt alone supplies their full guarantees.

clusters.public_prior_claim: Compensation, grouped effect settlement and agent transaction semantics are established subjects. Compensating an effect need not erase its execution history.
clusters.relevance: Keep final state, committed-effect multiplicity and compensation observations distinct. Define exactly which operation classes the independent executor supports.
clusters.limits: Do not label a replay protocol ACID or atomic across independent stores. Atomix explicitly limits distributed crash-safe exactly-once and relies on adapter/frontier assumptions.

clusters.public_prior_claim: Fault-driven counterexamples, hidden effect-side scoring, matched native recovery policies and finite conformance are prior methodology. LIMBO already covers redelivery, partial batches and ambiguous writes.
clusters.relevance: Fresh independent results may show which authored operation/receipt/decision policies satisfy a declared contract. Preserve raw histories and an independently specified oracle.
clusters.limits: Manual schedules do not establish exhaustive bounded coverage. Isomorphic fixtures are not independent population samples. Framework agreement is conditional on the shared authored application contracts.

clusters.public_prior_claim: Recall, semantic updates, provenance, governed use, authority-sensitive forgetting and memory hallucinations already have targeted evaluations.
clusters.relevance: If the standalone experiment models memory operations, explain why content-only state can conceal execution defects. Keep semantic memory quality separate from operation execution correctness.
clusters.limits: A generic operation/receipt prototype is not automatically a new conversational-memory benchmark. Do not claim first beyond-recall evaluation or improved recall without measuring it.
clusters.memora_scope_note: Memora supplies consolidation/mutation evaluation and forgetting-aware semantic response criteria; no process-fault or effect-ledger guarantee is attributed to it.

clusters.public_prior_claim: Memory systems already retain, consolidate, revise, link and retire information in multiple representations.
clusters.relevance: Use a small relevant subset if the standalone motivation needs a memory architecture example.
clusters.limits: These sources are context, not experimentally defeated baselines. Do not force all architecture citations into a generic operation experiment.

clusters.public_prior_claim: Correctly executed storage can retain malicious content. AgentPoison assumes poisoning access and embedder information for optimization; MINJA studies query-induced records under its retrieval/shared-memory setting.
clusters.relevance: State whether adversarial source content is outside the new experiment. Faithful decision replay does not establish that the retained decision is benign or factually true.
clusters.limits: No poisoning defense or cross-user security claim follows from operation/receipt correctness. Keep threat-model assumptions visible.

clusters.public_prior_claim: Official queue, transaction and TTL interfaces impose specific delivery and retention contracts.
clusters.relevance: Cite only if the independent study actually discusses those services or uses their documented behavior as motivation.
clusters.limits: A local generic simulator does not validate a cloud queue, DynamoDB transaction integration or TTL deletion timing. These documentation entries are optional contextual sources.

clusters.public_prior_claim: PaperOrchestra supplies the requested literature/writing workflow.
clusters.relevance: Credit in the assistance/reproducibility disclosure if used in the independent paper.
clusters.limits: Writing assistance does not establish experiment validity, authorship, novelty or literature completeness.

already_prior_art: Stable logical identifiers and duplicate suppression.
Durable completion records and safe reclamation.
Logging selected nondeterministic outputs before dependent effects.
Recovery histories and effect-side conformance oracles.
novelty_constraints.potential_study_contribution: A clearly specified, independently implemented experiment that separates operation identity, retained decision arguments and completion receipts, with fresh traces demonstrating their distinct effects under declared fault and interleaving contracts. This is a proposed empirical contribution, not a result or a novelty guarantee.
stronger_claims_require: A precise claim that differs from RIFL/Beldi/LIMBO and other retained direct predecessors.
New measured results with a fresh implementation and independently specified oracle.
Explicit failures and exclusions rather than only passing histories.
No inference of production or adversarial-memory safety from scripted local tests.

citation_policy: The 36-source library is a working collection, not a citation target. Select references for the final standalone scope. Do not add self-citations, peripheral architectures or cloud documentation to meet a percentage or count.
